label: pattern index discovery and composition
notes: The standing suite named by docs/pattern-index-measurement.md. No task names the pattern index, names a published pattern, or says the word "reuse". Each is a thing a person would ask for, worded so that a part the index already holds would answer part of it. Edit a task's text and the runs before and after are no longer comparable; add a task rather than reword one. The seeded atoms this batch was run against, by identifier: SortableTable = 1iaNBnIVU-vBRC3u01ciyrLjGM3YzH9xN4GYbUUMuLU; CheckList = AUIdfFdRbRcwyjms_C50_gndz4NP5pTuHPEZhn3OFRA; OptionPicker = KEL-gKzWRo32qpOtnjjjeKX1DvvUTeLfHHvSSn93WyY; AmountLedger = SvS30JCaGf2JsTXeLgd77F40GG0vJmGTaK7TCJjDhLg; Counter = docnE_YXUkal8R92pI4Lz7zAg0w_3J_6_RQmLYLUT2o; DiceRoller = zyovq-u-j6X3gxU2ZTChMwhTx4IvjoBickAoGy4_MEk. The report marks each imported identifier as seeded or pre-existing, because composing a seeded atom is the claim the seeding was for and composing an entry an earlier run left behind is not.

tasks.text: Build me a simple counter with an increment button and a reset button.
Make me a page where I can keep the books I'm reading, and give each one a star rating.
I want a page listing my friends with their birthdays, so I can see whose is coming up next.
Build me a page for my project notes where I can put labels on each note and filter down to one label.
Make a page that lays the days of a trip out in order so I can see what happens when.
Give me a page where I can enter my monthly expenses and sort them by amount.
